parsed.rationale: Both `LCDMinOffsetKey` and `LCDMaxOffsetKey` are type-alias-objects defined in the same file (`AccentColorEnvironment.swift`) within the `PlayerHeaderView` package, just four lines apart (lines 31 and 35). While they share structural shape (both are empty type-alias-objects with `shared_field_count: 1`), they encode semantically distinct concepts — a minimum offset key and a maximum offset key — that are intentionally paired as separate SwiftUI `EnvironmentKey` types. Collapsing them would destroy the semantic distinction between min and max offsets that the rest of the package relies on. No restraint markers are present, but the coincidence is purely structural; the domain concepts are deliberately separate.
